tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sgrub chen bka' brgyad rdzong 'phrang srog gsum gyi las byang dngos grub rol pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so// (112)

ye shes klong dgu'i sgyu 'phrul las/ sgrub chen dgu yi dkyil 'khor shar// gcig bsdus bla ma he ru ka /ngag gi dbang pos dge legs stsol/ mkhas pa mi bzhi'i thugs kyi bcud// snga 'gyur bka' ma'i bka' brgyad kyi// las byang khyer bde 'bri ba la// lha dang bla mas gnang ba stsol/ de yang kha bsgyur sde drug gi chings las/ dgon pa dben pa mi mi rgyu ba'i sar 'dus la/ dkyil 'khor dus gcig tu bskyed/ bsnyen pa dus gcig tu bsags/ mchod pa dus gcig tu 'bul/ bstod pa dus gcig tu bya/ dngos grub dus gcig tu blang ma/ phrin las dus gcig tu bcol lo// zhes gsungs pas dbang thob dam tshig la gnas pas yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su rten dang mchod pa'i rdzes tshang bar bsags nas phrin las dngos la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes/ dang po la brgyad kyi thog mar brgyud 'debs sngon 'gro nas bgaigs gtor/ (113) a mri ta sa bsang*/ swa bha wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rum̐ḥlas rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ aḥhūm̐ zhes 'bru gsum gyis brlabs/ bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ s+tha na pa ti k+ṣe tra pa lañtsa na ma sarba ta thā ga te= sogs kyi gsum gyis bsngos la/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la// dkyil 'khor don du sa phyogs 'di// bdag zhu khyed kyis brtsal du gsol// zhes gzhi bdag dang 'byung po'i tshogs la gtor ma byin pa sngon du 'gro bas/ dang po tshogs bsags pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas (114)bla ma rig 'dzin dpal chen gtso dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje slon dpon sangs rgyas dpal// dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo// mchog gsum bstan pa'i zhing gyur la// gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi// dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i// dag pa'i mchod pa bzhas su gsol// dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i gegs// nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi// phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos// ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*// dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do// bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/

dag pa gsum gyis lus 'bul lo// tshe rabs bsgrangs ba'i las rnams kun// bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo// sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ dang po bka' bsgo ba ni/ (115) badz+ra ma hā shṝ he ru konyahaṃ/ bdag nyid rdo rje khro bo'i skur gyur par bsam/ hūm̐ḥ bka' gsang rmad byung dkyil 'khor 'di// rgyal ba zhi khro'i bzhugs gnas yin// da lta nyid du gnas su dengs// ci ste mi 'gro bar gcod na// khro bo khro mo rigs lnga yi// sprul pa yang sprul khro tshogs kyis// lus sems rdul du brlag par bya// gdug sems ldan pa da lta thul// bgegs kyi tshogs rnams brlag par gyis/ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa kro ta dz+wa la ma ha la ha na ha la hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes bzla zhing drag sngags phur thun dang bcas pas bgegs/ bskrad/ gnyis pa mtshams bcad pa ni/ hūm̐/ mi bzad khro gtum rngams pa'i tshogs// khro bo'i sprul pas nam mkha' gang*// khro mo'i sprul pas sa gzhi gang*// bar snang khro chung sprul pas khyab// pho nya las byed du mar bcas// phyogs bcu kun tu rab tu gtams// oṃ lo ka sarba ma hā kro ta ya mān+ta ka pad+ma ta krita karmā kro ta ma ma ru lu sarba duṣ+ṭan hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces pas (116)phyogs bcur khro bo rol bu'i sprin gyis gtibs pa'i srung ba'i 'khoralos gtams pas cis kyang mi shigs bar bsam mo// gsum pa brda sgo bye ba ni/ hūm̐/ snang srid thams cad gzhal yas khang*// gzugs snang thams cad ye shes lha// ma rtogs ma rig sgo bcad pa// rang gsal ye shes sgo phyes shig /bh+rum̐ pra we sha ya phaṭaḥ ces snod bcud ye nas gzhal yas khang dang lhar rdzogs pa rtogs pa'i tshul gyis so// bzhi pa brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐/ rang byung ye shes sems kyi lhaḥ

ma rtogs rang ngo ma shes pas// ye nas 'grogs kyang zhal ma mthong*// rang gsal brda yis phyag 'tshal lo// a la la hoḥ a ti pū hoḥ pra tits+tsha hoḥ zhes snod bcud lha'i dkyil 'khor de nyid rang las gzhan du ma dmigs pa'i tshul gyis so// snga pa bshags pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐ḥ thog ma med pa'i dus nyid nas// rang dang gnyis su med mod kyang*// ma rig dbang gis yongs ma shes// rang byung ye shes lha la bshags// ces dang yig brgya bzla/ spro na spyi bshags ye shes sku mchog kyang bya'o// drug pa dam bca' ba ni/ hūm̐ḥ bskal pa sngon nas (117)bsgrubs pa'i lha// da lta rtse gcig 'du 'bral med// srog gi phyir yang mi spang na// bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol// a la la ho bho dhi tsit+ta hūm̐ḥ bdun pa byin dbab pa ni/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings ye shes lnga yi pho brang nas// chos sku skye med dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// longs sku rigs lnga zhi khro 'khor dang bcas// sprul sku 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams// thugs dam dbang gi gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol// gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di la byin cig phob/ rnal 'byor lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlobs// gsang ba'i dam rdzas gnyen po mchod par 'bul// khyed kyi thugs rje mchog gis bzung du gsol/ sa ma ya a we sha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥ zhes spos dang rol mor bcas pas byin dbab bo/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ḥ gis bdag gnas yo byad rnams la bstim mo// brgyad pa mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ḥ rang gi thugs ka nas ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros (118)ye shes kyi me rlung chur gyur pas mchod rdzas kyi dngos 'dzin nyes skyon thams cad bsregs gtor bskrus te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bhañdza 'bar ba'i snod bzang zhing rgya che ba rnams su hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i dngos po rnams 'dod yon gyi rnam pa ma tshang ba med pa 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu nam mkha'i mtha' blas par gang bar gyur/

oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+ta'i bar gyis byin gyis brlabs/ bdud rtsi la/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me kaṃ/ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che bar gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i steng du nyi ma la gnas pa'i go ku da ha na las sha lnga*/ bi mu ma ra shu las bdud rtsi lnga rnams kyi kha chod zla dkyil dkar po dbyangs gsal gyis mtshan pa'i lte ba rdo rje'i khong seng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ swa hā las rdo rje 'khor lo (119)rin chen pad+ma ral gri so so'i rigs kyi dril bu rnams su gyur/ hūm̐ badz+ra dh+rika/ mūm̐ dhā twi shwa ri/ oṃ dzi na jika/ lā twe ṣa ra ti/ swa rat+na dhṛka/ māṃ mo hā ra ti/ ām̐ a ro lika/ p+wāṃ ra ga rā ti/ hāpradz+nyā dhṛka/ tām̐ badz+ra ra ti/ de rnams la sku yongs su rdzogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yum dang bcas par gyur/ sa ma ya hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa amṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ rigs lnga yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ rgyal ba thams cad la mnyes mchod phul/ rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu nas tshur 'dus zhal du zhugs/ byang sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur pas sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ mkha' gsang las btan te dam tshig gi rdzas la 'dres pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por 'khyil ba'i rdo rje'i lte bar rta mgrin dmar po yum dang bcas pas mtshan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hū ྃhrīḥṭhaḥ zhes bdun nam nyer gcig bzla/ rak+ta la/ stong pa'i ngang las (120)rak+ta'i snod yum gyi mkha' dbyings su nyi ma la gnas pa'i ra yig dmar po las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrugs par gyur/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭaḥ de las chags pa chen po'i 'od zer 'phros/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ gdug pa can thams cad dbang du bsdus nas rak+ta la thim/ hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭaḥ yab kyi rdo rje tho bar gyur pas gzir zhing brdungs bas nyon mongs bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs nas rak+ta'i rgya mtsho zhing chen gyi lhum dum can zegs ma las 'dod yon gyi lha mo 'phro bar gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ bdun nam gsum bzla/ gtor ma la/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum la brten pa'i ye shes kyi kā pa la stong gsum mnyam pa'i steng du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga gtso bor gyur pa'i bza' bca' btung ba ldag gzhib 'dod yon lnga'i phung po zad mi shes par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā bha litaṃ te dzo bha li taṃ bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ gsum mam bdun brjod/ hūm̐ḥ gdod nas rang dang gnyis med lha/(121)/'du 'bral med pa'i lha tshogs la// ma rig spyan 'byed mar me dang*// 'bru bcu bdud rtsir sbyar ba'i skyems/ zhal zas rmad byung gtor ma dang*// chags med rak+ta'i ar+ghaṃ dang*// dam rdzas bdud rtsi sman gyi mchog// thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul lags na// gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang du bzhes/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ de dag ni sngon 'gro'i las rim mo// spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bcu gcig/ dang po ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum las de bzhin nyid ni/ hūm̐/ ma bcos pa ni chos kyi sku/ mtshan ma gzung 'dzin dri ma bral// rtog pa med pa nam mkha'i ngang*// de bzhin nyid du sgom par bya/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa arma konyahaṃḥ zhes chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi dag pa'i stong pa nyid la mnyam par bzhag kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi/ hūm̐ḥ ma rig 'khrul pa 'khor ba'i klong*// gzung 'dzin bag chags rab brtan nas// ma rtogs zo chu lta bur 'khor// kun tu snang du bsgom par bya// a dharam dha tu swa bh+wa wa arka konyahaṃ/ (122) de bzhin nyid ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams la brtse ba'i snying rje chen po kun tu snang bar khyab pa'o// rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ hūm̐ḥ chos rnams rten cinga'abrel bar ste// rgyu las ma byung gang yang med// sa bon las ni 'bras bu bzhin// rgyu'i yi ge bsgom par bya:

oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐ḥ stong nyid snying rje zung du mjug pa'i rang mdangs hūm̐ yig mthing nag nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ gnyis pa rten dang gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ nam mkha' gnas pa'i rgyu yi hūm̐ yig las e yam̐ bam̐ lam̐ sum̐ ram̐ rnams chad pa las/ e a ka sha maṇ+ḍa la/ yam̐ wa mu maṇ+ḍa la/ bam̐ sa mu dra maṇ+ḍa la/ lam̐ pri thi wi maṇ+ḍa la/ sum̐ gar+bhe maṇ+ḍa la/ ram̐ dza la maṇ+ḍa la/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ sam̐ ha ra na hūm̐ḥ zhes pas rten gyi skyir de nyid gsal gdab pa ni/ e las nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor byung*// rgya khyon dpag med kha dog dkar// gti mug dag pa'i rang bzhin te// kun tu bzang mo nam mkha'i dbyings// yam̐ las rlung gi da las byung*// dbyibs zlum kha dog sngon po la// (123)phrag dog dag pa'i rang bzhin te// yum chen sgrol ma'i mkha' klong dbyings// baṃ las chu yi da la byung*// dbyibs zlum kha dog sngon po la// 'dod chags dag pa'i rang bzhin te// ma ma ki yi mkha' yi klong*// lam̐ las gser gyi sa gzhi byung*// gru bzhi pa la kha dog ser// nga rgyal dag pa'i rang bzhin te// sangs rgyas spyan gyi mkha' yi klong*// sum̐ las gser gyi ri rab la// gru bzhi pa la kha dog bzhi// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs gnas rten// ram̐ las me yi da las byung*/ gru gsum pa la kha dog dmar// zhe sdang dag pa'i rang bzhin te// gos dkar mo yi mkha' yi klong*// 'dab stong pad+mar sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng*// rgyu yi hūm̐ las bh+rum̐ las bh+rum̐ yig lnga ldan babs// bh+rum̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe rat+na dz+nya na tsakra maṇ+ḍa la bh+rum̐ḥ bh+rum̐ yig gnas 'gyur sprul pa'i gzhal med khang*// gru bzhi sgo bzhi tshad dang mtshan nyid ldan// (124)gu ṇa ta ra t+ta babs bang rim bzhi// chos 'khor ri dwags gdugs dang nor bu'i tog// phyi rol rin chen brtsigs pa'i rming gi gzhir/ 'dod snam dmar ser lha mo bcu drug 'khod// pha gu ser po dra ba dra phyes mdzes// shar bu mda' yab khaṃ brtsegs rdo rje'i tog

/nang ni rdo rje'i gdung bzhi'i mig dmar ris// phyi 'khor rol gling brgyad dang rdo rje'i gur// bskal me 'ur 'ur chem chem 'bar ba'i klong*// 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang che// gru chad bzhi dang ling tshe lnga pa la// ma chags pad+ma thabs shes nyi zla 'bar// gang 'dul gdul bya sna tshogs gdan du gting*// pam̐ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ gsum pa brten gyi lha bskyed pa la/ zhi ba bsgom pa/ khro bor bsgyur ba/ de las kyang bka' brgyad rig 'dzin dang bcas pa bsgom pa'o// dang po ni/ rgyu yi sa bon gdan la babs pa de// so so'i phyag mtshan so so'i 'phro 'du las// dbus su dkyil 'khor bdag po rdo rje sems// mi bskyod zhal (125)gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing*// g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas dril bu la// zhabs gnyis mnyam bzhag yum dang gnyis med 'khril// rgyan dang phyag mtshan gtso bo yab dang mthun// shar du rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar// g.yas pas 'khor lo g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin// zhabs gnyis mnyam bzhag yum dang 'khril ba la// rgyan dang cha lugs gtso dang mthun pa'o// lho ru rin chen 'byung gnas sku mdog ser// g.yas pas rin chen g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin// zhabs gnyis mnyam bzhag yum dang 'khril ba la// rgyan dang cha lugs gtso dang mthun pa'o// nub tu a las snang ba mtha' yas dmar// g.yas pas pad+ma g.yon pas drim bu 'dzin// zhabs gnyis mnyam bzhag yum dang 'khril ba la// rgyan dang cha lugs gtso dang mthun pa'o// byang du ha las don yod grub pa ljang*// g.yas pas rgya gram g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin// zhabs gnyis mnyam bzhag yum dang 'khril ba la// rgyan dang cha lugs gtso dang (126)mthun pa'o// sems dpa' sems ma sgo ba thub pa rnams// mi bskyod 'khor na rang bzhin gnas pa ni// rgyal po'i 'khor na blon 'bangs gnas pa bzhin/ hūm̐ badz+ra dh+rika/

mum̐ dhā twe shwa ri/ oṃ dzi na dzika/ lāṃ te ṣa ra ti/ swa rat+na dh+rika/ maṃ mo ha ra ti/ āṃ a ro lika/ pāṃ ra ga ra ti/ ha pradz+nyaṃ dh+rika/ tāṃ badz+ra ra ti/ gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' badz+ra he ru kaḥ /mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa rdo rje g.yon pa dung khrag dkrugs// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum yum dang sbyor// rgyan dang cha lugs gtso dang mthun// rnam par snang mdzad budha he ru kaḥ /smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// g.yas pas 'khor lo g.yon pas dung khrag dkrugs// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum yum dang sbyor// rgyan dang cha lugs gtso dang mthun// rin chen 'byung gnas rat+na he ru kaḥ /ser nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// g.yas pas rin chen g.yon gyis thod (127)khrag dkrugs/ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum yum dang sbyor// rgyan dang cha lugs gtso dang mthun// snang ba mtha' yas pad+ma he ru kaḥ /dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// g.yas pa pad+ma g.yon pa thod khrag dkrugs// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum yum dang sbyor// rgyan dang cha lugs yab yum mthun// don yod grub pa karma he ru kaḥ /ljang nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// g.yas pas rgya gram g.yon pas thod khrag dkrugs// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum yum dang sbyor// rgyan dang cha lugs gtso dang mthun// ke seng sgo ma dbang phyug tshogs// rang bzhin gnas pa sgom par bya/ oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka hūm̐/ badz+ra kro ti shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ oṃ bhudha shrī he ru ka hūm̐/ bhud+dha kro ti shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ oṃ rat+na shrī he ru ka hūm̐/ rat+na kro ti shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka hūm̐/ pad+ma kro ti shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka hūm̐/ karma kro ti shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ (128)

gsum pa ni/ ling tshe lnga dang mtshams bzhi ru// gdul bya pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*// gtso mchog badz+ra he ru ka'iḥ thugs ka dpal be'u zur brgyad nas// ru lu yi ge 'bru brgyad gsal// sems kyi mar me gsal la 'bar/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ bud+dha he ru gnas 'gyur pa// bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed// smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// g.yas pas be con g.yon thod khrag /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum yum dang sbyor// rgyan dang cha lugs gtso dang mthun// thugs kar gser gyi 'khor lo na// gnas pa'i 'khor lo sems la gnas// sems la sems 'dus chos kyi sku// srid pa'i 'khor lo lte ba na// khams gsum srid gsum de na gnas// sprul pa'i 'khor lo zhabs 'og na// 'gro drug skye sgo de na gnas// gcod pa'i 'khor lo phyag mtshan na// phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med sgrub// sku la 'khor lo rnam bzhi rdzogs// oṃ a kro ti (129)ka ya man+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭaḥ rat+na he ru gnas 'gyur pa// che mchog bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ni/ sngo ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// g.yas g.yon thal mo brang du bsnol// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum yum dang sbyor// rgyan dang cha lugs yab dang mthun/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ pad+ma he ru gnas 'gyur pa// dbang chen pad+ma rta mchog sku// dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// g.yas pas pad+ma g.yon thod khrag /dbu gtsug rta mgo rta skad 'tsher// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum yum dang sbyor// rgyan dang cha lugs yab dang mthun// oṃ pad+ma ta krita ma hā kro ta ha ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ karma he ru gnas 'gyur pa// bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu ni// ljang nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// g.yas g.yon rdo rje phur pa 'dril// zhabs gnyis brkyang (130)bskum yum dang sbyor// rgyan dang cha lugs yab dang mthun//

oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bhigh+naṃ baṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ shar lhor bla med he ru kaḥ /mthing nag rdo rje thod khrag dkrug /kun tu bzang mo yum dang sbyor// oṃ gugya dz+nyā na shrī he ru ka kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭaḥ lho nub rig 'dzin rdo rje dkar// thod dbyug g.yas la dril bu g.yon// bde chen rdo rje rnal 'byor yum// oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭaḥ nub byang dregs pa kun 'dul mthing*// tho ba g.yas la mdung thung g.yon// khams gsum srid pa spyi 'dul yum// oṃ badz+ra tsan+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ byang shar stobs ldan nag po che// lcags kyu g.yas la sbrul zhags g.yon// 'byung ba lnga yi bdag mo yum// gzugs khams mkhar 'degs 'dod khams gnon// oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ kun kyang rigs bzhi'i 'khor dang bcas// zhabs gnyis lha chen pho mo brdzis/ mtshams bzhi'i yum rnams sku mdog mthing*/ gri gug thod 'dzin yab la 'khyud/(131)phyi rol sgo ba rigs bzhi ni// lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril// tshom bu dgu yi dkyil 'khor la// bdun brgya nyer lnga'i lha tshogs kun// nyi las 'od zer ji bzhin shar// sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs// ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chen por gsal// oṃ badz+ra sarba yak+sha sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces gsal gdab bo/ bzhi pa dbang bskur ba ni/ rigs lnga'i phyag rgya spyi bo'i gnas lngar 'ching shing*/ oṃ ma hā shun+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma konyahaṃ/ oṃ ma hā ang r+sha dz+nya na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+mā konyahaṃ/ oṃ ma hā sa ma ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wā at+mā konyahaṃ/ oṃ ma hā pra t+ya be k+ṣa ṇa dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa at+mā konyahaṃ/ oṃ ma hā kri t+ya nuṣatra na dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa at+mā konyahaṃ/ spyi bo'i gnas lngar de bzhin gshegs pa lnga rjes chags kyi zhu ba'i ye shes lnga'i chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ nyon mongs pa lnga sbyangs/

phung po lnga sangs rgyas lngar gnas 'gyur nas dbang rtags su (132)de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas dbu rgyan par gyur/ lnga pa byin gyis rlab pa ni/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya gnas gsum du 'ching shing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa at+mā konyahaṃ/ de bzhin du/ wāka/ tsit+ta= sogs/ rang gi spyi mgrin snying gar zla ba pad+ma nyi ma la gnas pa'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ de'i 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang bar byon nas yi ge gsum la thim/ yongs su gyur pa las rnam snang 'od dpag med mi bskyod pa dang bcas pa'i skur gyur par bsam mo/ drug pa spyan drangs pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dpal chen dkyil 'khor dgu'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐ḥ 'gro ba'i rnam rtog bzlog pa dang*// dbang bskur byin gyis rlob pa dang*// thugs rje yis ni dgongs mdzod la// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'das// dam tshig dkyil 'khor gsal bskyed de// ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan 'dren na// rgyal ba zhi khro 'khor (133)dang bcas// dkyil 'khor 'di la brtan par bzhugs// pho brang 'di la byin cig phob// 'phags 'chog thugs rje'i dus la bab// khyad par bstan pa'i dus la bab// mthu chen mthu stsol rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs// byin chen byin phob rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs// dngos grub mchog stsol rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs// bdag cag las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// oṃ shrī badz+ra kro dha he ru ka sa pā ri wā ra e a ral+li hring hring dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes spyan drangs/ bdun pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ḥ rtogs par gyur pa'i dus nyid na// dam tshig ye shes gnyis med de// chu la chu bzhag ji bzhin du// du ma ro gcig ngo mtshar che'o// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho sa ma ya ā we sha ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/

zhes ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa la gnyis med du bzhugs par gyur/ brgyad pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐/ chos rnams rang bzhin ye nas dag /rtog 'khrul 'jig rten sems can la// sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las (134)kyi// byams pa'i char chen cir yang 'bebs// thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pu ho/ pra tits+tsha ho/ dgung pa mchod pa la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dang po la gnyis las dngos 'byor ni/ hūm̐/ dwangs bsil snyogs med yid 'ong mchod yon sbreng*// dag byed zhabs bsil dri ldan gaṅga'i rgyun// thang skyes chu skyes rnam bkra'i me tog tshal// lhan cig skyes dang yongs sbyar bdug pa'i sprin// mar me nyin mor byed pa'i gzugs gsar pa// dri chab sim pa mchog skyed rol mtshor spel// zhal zas lha yi bdud rtsi'i ro brgya'i dpyid// rol mo snyan 'jebs yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra// ngo mtshar mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam yas pa// rab 'byams nam mkha'i khyon rnams bkang ste 'bul// oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+ta pū dza hoḥ yid sprul ni/ hūm̐/ 'dzam bu'i gser 'khor yid bzhin nor bu mchog /yid 'ong btsun mo blo ldan khyim bdag ste/(135) /stobs ldan glang po cang shes rta yi mchog /phas rgol mthar byed dmag dpon rin chen bdun// mdzes sdug gzugs dang snyan brjid rol mo'i sgra// dri zhim dang ldan bcud ldan bdud rtsi'i zas// 'jam mnyen reg bya bkra shis rtags rdzas sogs// srid zhi'i 'byor tshogs nam mkha'i mdzod du 'bul/ oṃ shri badz+ra he ru ka sa pā ri wa ra sap+ta ma hā rat+na pañtsa ka ma gu ṇa pū dza hoḥ gnyis pa nang gi mchod pa la drug las/ dang po phyag rgya gar mchod ni/ hūm̐/ gdul bya mos pa tha dad pas// zhi dang khro bo 'dres pa'i tshul// sku mdog zhal phyag bsam las 'das// gar dbyangs phyag rgya'i mchod pa 'bul/ ma hā mudrā pū dza ho/

zhes lha'i phyag rgya bca'/ gnyis pa 'dod yon rnams mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ rdo rje sgeg mo gzugs mdzos ma// phreng ba ma ni rgyan phreng 'dzin// glu ma glu len pi waṃ brdung*/// gar ma mdzes pa'i gar bsgyur ma// me tog ma ni me tog 'thor//(136)bdug pa ma ni spros sprin spro// mar me ma ni snang gsal 'dzin// dri ma dri mchog byug pa 'bul/ brgyad ka'ang gzugs mdzes lta na sdug /yi 'ong gar bsgyur glu len ma// 'chi med bu mo lta bu yis/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten bkang te 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra ma le hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra mā le traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gi rti hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra nirti āḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhubape traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ālo ke hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra ghanadhe āḥ gsum pa dam rdzas 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ gdug pa can rnams tshar bcad pa'i// dbang po'i me tog phreng bar spel// tshil chen gsur gyi dud pa'i sprin// mi bzad mun pa lta bur 'tshubs// zhun mar mchog gi sgron me ni// dus ma'i zhugs kyi phung por 'bar// khrag mkhris dri dang yongs sbyar ba'i// wu phreng rab 'khrugs byug pa'i rjas// sha khrag rus pa don snying tshogs// lhun por spungs pa'i zhal zas mchog /thong rnga rkang gi gling bu sogs// rab 'jigs (137)sgra dbyangs rgya mtshor bcas// dur khrod mchog gi mchod sprin ni// gshin rje'i 'dun sa bzhin du 'bul// oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa pā ri wa ra ma hā sha ma shā na puṣ+paṃ dhu paṃ dī saṃ ghanadhaṃ ne wi d+ye shab+ta pū dza ho: bzhi pa bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi/ rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman// rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos// ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas// rgyud drug sems can kun sgrol phyir// dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi che// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ hūm̐/

rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar ba'i// thun mong mchog dang khyad 'phags 'di/ dus gsum bla ma yi dam lha// rgyal ba zhi khro thams cad la/ rnam dag bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rjes dbang dang dngos grub stsol// sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā raṃ kha hiḥ ston pa kun bzang rdo rje sems dpa' che// rab dgyes rdo rje dpal ldan seng ge 'od// mkhas pa mi bzhi dri med zla shar la// sman mchod 'bul lo (138)dbang dang dngos grub stsol// sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes rgya mtsho dang*// pad+ma dbang rgyal tshul khrims rgyal ba'i mtshan// ldan btson ye shes dbang phyug so ston la// sman mchod= sarba= grub thob dngos grub mnga' bdag nyi ma 'od// 'gro ba'i mgon po gu ru chos kyi dbang*// pad+ma dbang chen shes rab rgyal po la// sman mchod= sarba= zur haṃ shaka 'byung shaka rdor bshes dpal gnyis// ra legs zung dang se ston rin chen rgyal/ mnga' ris paṇa chen pad+ma dbang rgyal la// sman= sarba= ngag dbang tshe brtan rgyal po nam mkhar spyod// pa ra hi ta phrin las lhun gyi grub// bstan pa'i nyi ma 'gyur med rdo rje la// sman= sarba= rin chen rnam rgyal o rgyan rig pa 'dzin// theg mchog bstan 'dzin a ti bstan pa'i rgyal// rin chen rgya mtsho phrin las dar rgyas la// sman= sarba= pad+ma bkra shis kun mkhyen gzhan phan zhabs// pad+ma badz+ra 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// mdo sngags bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma (139)la/ sman= sarba= bka' gter zab rgyas chos tshul rab 'byams kyi// smin grol gdams pa'i bdud rtsi mchog sbyin mkhan/ bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ sman= sarba= yang dag 'jam dpal gshin rje pad+ma dbang*// rdo rje gzhon nu bla med he ru ka: che mchog rig 'dzin dregs 'dul drag sngags la// sman= sarba= legs ldan nag po chen po tshogs kyi bdag// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro dam can gter bdag dang*// gnas bdag gzhi bdag dkar phyogs skyong rnams la// sman mchod=

sarba pañtsa amṛ ta khā raṃ khā hi/ zhes dbul/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐/ lce yi rdo rje dam tshig las// rdo rje can gyi ā+oṃ bsgoms te// theb dang srin lag rtse sbyar nas/ thabs dang shes rab phyag rgya yi// myang na dngos grub mchog thob 'gyur// kā ya sid+dhi oṃḥ wā ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐ḥ zhes pa mtheb srin gyi bdud rtsi rang gi gnas gsum du reg cing lces myong*/ lnga pa gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ drug pa rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ (140) hūm̐/ nyon mongs rtsa ba 'khor ba'i khrag /rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ sbreng*/ mchod sbyin dam rdzas chen po 'di// thugs dam bskang phyir bzhes su gsol// ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ gsum pa gsang ba'i mchod pa la gsum las/ dang po sbyor mchod ni/ hūm̐/ dbyings rig gnyis med sbyor ba yis/ 'khor 'das gnyis su med par sbyor// gnyis med rtogs pa'i sbyor mchod 'di// 'gro ba'i don du thugs rjes bzhes/ bho dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha.a nu ra ga ya mi/ gnyis pa sgrol mchod ni/ hūm̐/ yang dag don rtogs blo yis ni// ma rtogs sems can gnas su bsgral// dus gsum bde gshegs de la mnyes// mchog gi mchod chog pa chen po 'di// 'gro ba'i don du thugs rdzas bzhes/ sarba sha trum̐ mā ra ya rbad/ gsum pa gnyis su med pa'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dgongs spyod la// mchod dang ma mchod gnyis med kyang*/ rdzas sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin// dbyangs dang bcas te gus pas 'bul// 'gro ba'i don tu thugs rjes (141)bzhes// dharma dharmā ma hā su kha pū dza hoḥ bcu pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ mnyam nyid sku yi rang bzhin ni// kun bzang zag pa med par bde// sems can don la bde bar gshegs// thugs rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ rtsol med rang byung chos kyi sgra// ma 'gags pa la 'jigs pa med// chags bral skye med rdo rje'i gsung*// yang dag gsung la=

hūm̐/ spros pa med pa dbyings kyi ngang*// ma skyes 'jigs med rdo rje'i thugs// blang dor med pa chos kyi dbyings// 'gyur med thugs la= hūm̐/ chos dbyings rol pa chen po las// brtsal dang rtsol bar mi dmigs kyang*// nam mkha' mdzod kyis chos 'phrul gyis// yon tan re skong phyag 'tshal bstod/ hūm̐/ rang bzhin cir yang ma nges kyang*// dkyil 'khor chen pos cha bzung na// rtog med dregs pa ngang gis 'dul// phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// mthing ga rdo rje dril bu bsnams// rdo rje dbyings phyug yum dang sbyor/(142)/gnyis su med la phyag 'tshal bstod/ hūm̐/ rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs// dkar po 'khor lo dril bu bsnams// yum chen sangs rgyas spyan dang sbyor// gnyis su med la= hūm̐/ rin chen 'byung gnas de bzhin gshegs// ser po rin chen dril bu bsnams// rin chen dbyings phyug yum dang sbyor// gnyis su= hūm̐/ snang ba mtha' yas de bzhin gshegs// dmar po pad+ma dril bu bsnams// pad+ma dbyings phyug yum dang sbyor/ gnyis su= hūm̐/ don yod grub pa de bzhin gshegs// ljang gu rdo rje dril bu bsnams// las kyi dbyings phyugs yum dang sbyor// gnyis su med la= hūm̐/ khrag 'thung badz+ra he ru kaḥ mthing nag rdo rje thod khrag bsnams// badz+ra kro ti yum dang sbyor// gnyis su= hūm̐/ khrug thung bhud+dha he ru kaḥ smug nag 'khor lo thod khrag bsnamasaḥ bhud+dha kro ti yum dang sbyor// gnyis su= hūm̐/ khrag 'thung rat+na he ru kaḥ ser nag rin chen thod khrag bsnams// rat+na kro ti yum dang sbyor// gnyis su= hūm̐/ khrag 'thung karma he ru kaḥ dmar nag pad+ma thod khrag bsnams// pad+ma kro ti yum dang sbyor/ gnyis su=(143)hūm̐/ khrag 'thung karma he ru kaḥ /ljang nag rgya gram thod khrag bsnams// karma kro ti yum dang sbyor// gnyis su med la=

hūm̐/ dpal chen khro rgyal gshin rje gshegs// smug nag be con thod khrag bsnams// be ta nag mo yum dang sbyor// gnyis su= hūm̐/ dpal chen rta mgrin dbang gi sku/ dmar nag pad+ma thod khrag bsnams// pad+ma gzi ldan yum dang sbyor// gnyis su= hūm̐/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu ni// ljang nag rdo rje phur pa 'dril// 'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum dang sbyor// gnyis su med= hūm̐ḥ dpal chen bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ni// ljang nag bdud rtsi thal mo zed// rtsi sman rgyal mo yum dang sbyor// gnyis su= hung*/ dpal chen bla med he ru kaḥ mthing nas rdo rje thod khrag dkrugs/ kun rgyu bzang mo yum dang sbyor/ gnyis su= hūm̐/ dpal chen rig 'dzin rdo rje chos// dkar gsal thod dbyug dril bu 'dzin// rdo rje rnal 'byor yum dang sbyor// gnyis su= hūm̐/ dpal chen dregs pa kun 'dul (144)rje// mthing nag tho ba mdung thung gsor/ khams gsum spyi 'dul yum dang sbyor// gnyis su= hūm̐/ dpal chen stobs ldan nag po che// mthing nag lcags kyu sbrul zhags thogs// 'byung lnga'i bdag mo yum dang sbyor// gnyis su= hūm̐/ dpal chen spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin// zhi sogs phrin las rnam pa bzhis/ tshar gcod rjes 'dzin mthu stobs can// dpal gyi bka' sdod tshogs la bstod/

ces bstod do/ bcu gcig pa dzab bzla ba ni/ rang gi thugs rin po che zur brgyad pa mchong gur phub pa lta bu'i klong du pad nyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba/ de'i mthar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i mi 'gyur ba'i thig le hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng ba rnams shin tu phra ba'i gzugs kyi gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba rnams mchod cing 'gro ba'i don byas// byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad bsdus nas bdag la thim/ snod bcud dag pa lha dang (145)gzhal yas khang gi rang bzhin dang grags stong sngags sgras zhing khams thams cad yongs su gang bar bsamal/ lhar snang rim pas gsal zhing mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bgrang phreng bzung ste/ hūm̐ badz+ra dh+rika mūm̐ dwa te sha ri/ zhes rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po'o/ oṃ dzi na dzi ka lām̐ te ṣa ra ti/ rnam snang ngo*/ swa rat+na dhṛkamaṃ mo ha ra ti/ rin 'byung ngo*/ āṃ a ro lī ka pāṃ rā ga ra ti/ snang mtha'o/ ha pra dz+nya dh+rika/ taṃ badz+ra ra ti/ don grub bo/ oṃ badz+ra shri he ru ka hūm̐/ badz+ra kro ti shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ rdo rje khrag 'thung ngo*/ oṃ bhud+dha shrī he ru ka hūm̐/ bhud+dha kro ti shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ sangs rgyasaso/ oṃ rat+na shri he ru ka hūm̐/ rat+na kro ti shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ rin chen no/ oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka hūm̐/ pad+ma kro ti shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ pad+ma'o/ oṃ karma shri he ru ka hūm̐/ karma kro ti shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ las kyi 'o/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ yang dag go/ oṃ a kro te ka ya man+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭaḥ gshin rje'o/ (146) oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ hrīḥthaḥ bdud rtsi'o/ oṃ pad+ma ta kri ta ma hā kro dha h+ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ rta mgrin no/ oṃ badz+ra kī li ki la ya sarba bigh+naṃ baṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ phur pa'o/

oṃ guh+ya dz+nyā na shrī he ru ka kro ti shā ri hūm̐ phaṭa: ma ma'o/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭa: rig 'dzin no/ oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sarba duṣ+ḍan hūṃ phaṭaḥ dregs pa'o/ oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ḍaṃ hūṃ phaṭaḥ drags sngags so/ oṃ badz+ra sarba yak+sha sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭaḥ bka' sdod do/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+ma kro ti shwa ri badz+ra kī li ki la ya/ ma hā yak+ṣa ka la ru pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces spyi dril drag sngags so lnga pa'o// de dag gi dmigs rim rgyas pa sgrub khog skabs su 'byung ngo*// de ltar gtso 'khor gyi dbye bas ji tsam nus pa'i bar bzlas mtshams so sor stong tshig gi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul// sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las bstod/(148) /bag med 'gal 'khrul nyams chags bshags/ ma hā a mṛ ta bha ling ta rak+ta khā hi/ zhes mchod pa'ang bya'o// de ltar bcu gcig ni dngos gzhi'i rim pa'o// spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la bcu gnyis las/ dang po tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba ni/ zhing ngam gcan gzan gyi lpags pa'i khar bza' btung gi dngos po ci 'byor bshams la byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ hūm̐ rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes kyis// chos kun sgyu mar rig pa las// rig pa'i ye shes raṃ yaṃ khaṃ// raṃ las me 'bar dngos 'dzin bsregs// yaṃ las rlung g.yos bag chags gtor// khaṃ las chu byung gnyis 'dzin bkrus// raṃ yaṃ khaṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭaḥ slar yang bh+ruṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ 'phros pas mtshan ldan kā pā lar// bh+rum̐ gyis 'dod yon tshogs su gyur// oṃ gyi dngos 'dzin dri ma sbyangs// a yi nam mkha' gang bar spel// hūm̐ gis gang mos de ltar bsgyur// hrīḥyis zag med bdud rtsir zhu// phun tshogs 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs// bde gshegs rigs lnga'i dam tshig rdzas// rgya chen gting zab lhun sdug pa// ngo mtshar mchod sprin chen por gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes byin gyis brlab bo/ tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba zhi khro 'khor dang bcas// ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren/ dam tshig dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir bzhugs// dga' dang gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra lā se hūm̐ḥ oṃ badz+ra mā le trāṃḥ oṃ badz+ra gī gīrti hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra nirtī āḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐ḥ oṃḥ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ oṃ badzar ghan+dhe āḥ zhes dang mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ gzugs mdzes sgra snyan drizhim dang*// ro ldan zhal zas reg na bde// gar dang glu dang chos kyi tshim// 'dod yon lha mos nam mkha' gang*// zhi khro dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// thugs dam brkang la dngos grub stsol// (149)oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pañtsa ka ma gu ṇa pra tits+tsha swa hā/ bshags pa ni/ hūm̐/ zhal zas bdud rtsi tshogs mchod 'di// rang byung ye shes lha rnams la// thugs dam bskong phyir 'bul lags na/ g.yar dam nyams pa bskang phyir bzhes// yi ge brgya pa bzla/ tshogs tha ma ni/ dmigs bya'i gzugs brnyan bcas la/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*// chos kyi= dge bdun gyi= gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang gzungs sngags dang snying po dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi= chos nyid gdod nas stongs kyang chos can/ rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i= khyad par bcom ldan 'das bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i spyi dgra/ khyad par rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la snga dgra lag gis brdar ba/ (150)phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra thad du 'dzugs pa'i gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra dang*/ gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad srid pa gsum gyi khongs gar gnas gar bros kyang*/

skad cig yud tsam la dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig drag sngags so lnga'i mthar/ ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes 'gugs gzhug byas la/ hūm̐/ rnal 'byor sgrub la bar gcod bgegs// tshogs la bstim te bsgral bar bya// dug gsum srid pa'i btson khang du// rno dbal 'bar ba'i mtshon cha yis// gzugs phung rdul phran bzhin du gshig /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su spor// drag sngags so lnga'i mthar/ sarba nri tri sha trum̐ ma ra ya phaṭaḥ ces bsgral/ bstab pa ni/ hūm̐/ dug gsum sha khrag rus pa'i tshogs// zag med bdud rtsir 'bul lags na// 'khor ba dbyings su bsgral ba'i phyir// rngams pa'i stabs kyis bzhes su gsol// māṃ sa rak+ta king ni (151)ri ti a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ ling ro rnams gtor mar bstabs/ chung tsam lhag gtor la'ang bsre'o// de nas/ hūm̐/ zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di// 'dod yon ma spangs longs spyod rgyan// dngos grub sna tshogs 'di las 'byung*// rnal 'byor tshogs la dgyes par rol// a la la ho/ zhes brda dang brda'i spis 'bul len byas nas tshogs la rol/ lhag gtor ni/ lhag ma rnams snod gcig tu bsdus pa'i dme gtor dang*/ gtsang lhag rnams gra la rim du bshams la/ hūm̐/ dang po phud kyis mi mchod rgyu// dpal chen lha tshogs phud kyi bdag// bar du sprin ltar mi gtib rgyu// dge ba'i bshes gnyen gnyan gyi bdag /tha ma gcig tu mi bsre rgyu// ma tshogs dbang phyug lhag ma'i gnas// lhag ma kha chus mi gdab rgyu// khyed dang nged gnyis dam tshig gcig /ye nas 'du 'bral med don tu// 'dus la las rnams kun byes shig / de nas phud lhag gcig tu (152) dril/ slob dpon bla med he ru kar gsal bas dam tshig gi kha phrus/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ sa/ lhag ma'i dam tshig 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes pa nam mkha' gang bar gyur bar bsam la lhag bsdus kyi kho nya rnams/

oṃ guh+ya dz+nyā na shrī he ru ka kro ti shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭaḥ e ā l+li hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ zhes dang sprugs pa'i sgra drag pos spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ shab+ta pra ti ts+tsha swa hā/ zhes me tog la sogs pas mchod nas/ hūm̐/ ma dang mkha' 'gro dam chen ma// bstan pa srung ba'i las mkhan ma// rdo rje'i rigs dang rin chen rigs// pad+ma'i rigs dang las kyi rigs// ye shes mkha' gro thams cad kyang*// dam tshig gnyan gyi gtor ma longs// rnal 'byor byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bstan srung bka' yi bya ra ba// lha mo mon mo bal mo dang*// rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro thams cad kyang*// dam tshig gnyen gyi gtor ma long*// bstan pa gnyen po bsrung du gsol// dbang phyug mkha' 'gro 'bar mdang*/ ma sring ging dang lang ka dang*// las kyi mkha' 'gro thams cad kyang*// dam tshig gnyen gyi gtor ma longs/(153)rnal 'byor rkyen dbang bzlog tu gsol// oṃ uts+tshi ṣ+ṭa bha li taṃ bhak+ṣabhe swa hā/ zhes gtor ma phyi rol du dor/ gnyis pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐/ dpal chen badz+ra he ru kaḥ sgrub chen brgyad kyi tshogs dang bcas// bskul lo sems can don du bskul/ mdzod cig drag po'i phrin las mdzod// hūm̐/ zhe sdang dregs pa gshin rje ni// mthing nag be con thod khrag thogs// bran 'khor g.yog bzhin phrin las mdzod// hūm̐/ 'dod chags dregs pa ma mo ni// dmar nag snying dang thod khrag thogs// bran 'khor g.yog= hūm̐/ nga rgyal dregs pa ging chen ni// dkar po shel gri thod khrag thogs// bran khol= hūm̐/ phrag dog dregs pa rmu btsan ni// dmar nag shang lang thod khrag thogs// bran khol= hūm̐/ las kyi dregs pa dgra lha ni// smug po rdo rje thod khrag thogs// bran khol= hūm̐/ nga rgyal dregs pa gnod sbyin ni// ser po ru dar thod khrag thogs// bran khol= hūm̐/ gti mug dregs pa klu bdud ni// nag po (154)sbrul zhags rus sbal thogs// bran khol=

hūm̐/ 'jig rten dregs pa gza' bdud ni// dud kha chu srin thod khrag thogs// bran khol g.yog bzhin phrinalas mdzod// ya ma ra tsa sa ma ya dzaḥ trag sha kha mun+t+ra dzaḥ tri du ru hrī du ru dhu ru tar ti dzaḥ ga su la ra tri ni tra sha yaṃ dzaḥ badz+ra sa du sa ma ya ra tsa tri dzaḥ hring badz+ra yak+sha badz+ra hring hring dzaḥ na ga ra tsa sa ma ya phu dzaḥ ra hu la ma trig dzaḥ sha trum̐ ni thuṃ dzaḥche ge mo mā ra ya rbad/ zhes bskul lo// gsum pa chad tho bsgrag pa ni/ slob dpon dregs 'dul du gsal bas dregs pa spa skong te/ hūm̐/ bka' yi bstan pa bsrung mdzad pa// gshin rje bdud dang ma mo dang*// gza' dang klu dang btsan dang lha// gnod sbyin srin po dgra lha rnams// lha srin sde brgyad thams cad kyang*// dam chos gnyen gyi gtor ma longs// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung du gsol// zhar byung du slob dpon stobs ldan nag por bzhengs pas gtor ma zor du bskul ba ni/ (155) hūm̐/ drag po thun gyi gtor ma 'di// sdang dgra gnod pa'i bgegs la brdeg /lnga phung gzugs la gtor zor rgyob// lus ngag yid gsum thal bar rlogs// dgra gegs las ngan rtsad nas chod// oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭan hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes pas zor du 'phangs/ bzhi pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te/ hūm̐/ tshogs dang bka' yi tshogs bcas nyid// khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs skyong ma rnams// 'dir byon dam bskang phrin las mdzod// bdag nyid chen mo la sogs bdud mo bzhi// gangs dkar sha med la sogs gnod sbyin bzh-i// kong btsun de mo la sogs sman mo bzhi// bod khams skyong ba'i che zhe chen mo rnams// bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas// lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas// sil snyan mang po'i sgra dang bcas// 'dir byon dam skongs phrin las mdzod// che zhe chen mo khyed rnams kyang*// a su ra yi brag phug (156)tu/

slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*// rlangs chen dpal gyi seng ge yis// zhing chen stan la bkod nas kyang*// lag tu rdo rje gtad nas ni// dbang bskur gsang ba'i mtshan nas brjod// rdo rje 'chang gi gral du bzhag// bod khams srung zhing skyong ba dang*// rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i grogs bya zhes// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i// g.yar dam gnyen po rjes dgong la/ dam rdzas bka' yi gtor ma longs// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// oṃ la la*/ le le/ taṃ taṃ/ teṃ teṃ/ kha rak+ma ma ma sriṃ 'gro ma hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes gtor ma phyir dor/ lnga pa rta bro ni/ mdun du drag po e'i nang du dmigs bya bcug ste gtor gzhong ri rab tu gyur pas mnan par bsam la/ hūm̐/ gtor phyir 'brang ba'i dam sri rnams// rnal 'byor 'khor la bar gcod bgegs// gtor gzhong ri rab 'og tu mnan// bskal pa'i mthar yang mi btang bar// lus ngag yid gsum nan gyis mnan// oṃ laṃ āḥlaṃ hūm̐ (157)sri nan/ drug pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐/ lha dang rig 'dzin thams cad la// dbang dang dngos grub zhu ba ni// 'dir 'dus rig 'dzin bdag cag la// smin grol gnyis kyis rgyud sbyangs nas// bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis las gzhung bsrang*// bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi mtha' ru chub// las dang thugs rje mthun pa yis// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ bdun pa mchod bstod naungs bshags ni/ slar yang gtang rag gi don du mchod pa ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa pā ri wa ra ma hā sha ma shā na puṣ+paṃ dhubapaṃ dī baṃ ghanadhe nai wi d+ya shab+ta pu dza ho/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā bha ling ta khā hi/ zhes dang*/ yang dag 'jam dpal gshin rje pad+ma dbang*// rdo rje gzhon nu bla med he ru ka /che mchog rig 'dzin dregs 'dul drag sngags sogs// bka' brgyad lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//

zhes bstod yi ge brgya pa tshar mang du brjod (158)pa'i mthar/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang*// gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas// 'dir ni bgyi ba gang nongs pa// de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzad rigs// zhes bzod gsol bya/ brgyad pa gshegs shing bsdu ba ni/ mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod sogs kyi tha ma yin na/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ badz+ra muḥ zhes ye shes pa gshegs su gsol nas dam tshig pa bsdu/ thun mtshams su la 'jug pa'am nyal ba na dam ye ma phye bar/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ snang sid thams cad 'od du zhu nas gzhal yas khang la thim/ gzhal yas khang 'khor gyi lha tshogs la thim/ 'khor rnams rim gyis gtso bo la thim/ gtso bo ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ ye shes sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la thim/ dwangs ma'i srog hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ gyen rdzogs nā da mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag te rtag mtha' bsal/ dgu pa rgyun gyi spyod lam na
